title: Single traceable design path for the technician
statement: The technician shall be able to go from an imported cranial scan to an approved, exported positive-mould STL with every design parameter recorded inside one application.
rationale: Published CRO workflow chained 5-6 programs and reported no rectification parameters; fragmentation plus unrecorded rules is the main gap found.
acceptance_criteria: See UR-01..UR-08 and VER-10

title: Case records for the clinic
statement: The clinic shall be able to retrieve, for any patient episode, every scan, measurement set, design version, export and report produced for it.
rationale: Case/patient files are standard in O&P suites (CASE 4 V/1 P); traceable case documentation is in project scope.
priority_rationale: Traceability is a project scope item
acceptance_criteria: See UR-05

title: Measurements comparable with the physician's method
statement: The prescribing physician (outside the platform) shall receive cranial index values together with the exact definition used to compute them.
rationale: The clinic's CVAI formula is not disclosed; published variants differ and modalities are not interchangeable.
priority_rationale: Values without definitions can be mis-compared (R-17)
acceptance_criteria: See FR-044, SAF-06

title: Manufacturable hand-off
statement: The positive-mould production step shall receive a watertight STL in millimetres, in a documented coordinate frame, that imports into Rodin4D Neo.
rationale: Clinic thermoforms over a positive; production machine unknown; Neo imports STL.
priority_rationale: Without it the MVP has no output
acceptance_criteria: See FR-100..FR-103

title: Specialist-support intended use
statement: The product shall operate and be described only as a specialist-support tool: it shall not determine candidacy, prescribe correction, classify severity or claim clinical outcomes.
rationale: Intended-use boundary set by owner; avoids intended-use creep (R-01).
acceptance_criteria: See SAF-01, SAF-02, FR-045, NFR-06

title: Protection of infant data
statement: Infant personal data shall be handled under the privacy and security requirements SEC-10…SEC-18 and VER-22, which must be approved before any real scan is uploaded.
rationale: Owner deferred privacy rules; risk R-08 (H severity) stays open.
source: OQ-010; R-08; DEC-019, DEC-021 (owner, 2026-11-12); clinic contract
priority_rationale: Need is real; detailed requirements deferred by owner
acceptance_criteria: VER-22 inspection record signed; SEC-17 gate enabled only after it
v0.2_change: AUD-03: statement changed; AUD-03: acceptance_criteria changed; AUD-03: release changed; AUD-03: priority changed; AUD-03: verified_by changed; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Measurable added value vs incumbent CAD
statement: The pilot shall report (1) technician design time in Jude against the clinic's current design process for comparable cases and (2) agreement between Jude measurements and the clinic's manual measurements; the clinic sets the acceptance threshold for each.
rationale: Clinic already runs Rodin4D and Pi.Cas.So.; without a stated criterion the pilot can show no value (R-18).
acceptance_criteria: Both measures reported (VER-10, VER-23); thresholds recorded by the clinic before pilot end; result stated against each threshold
v0.3_change: DEC-030: statement; DEC-030: acceptance_criteria; DEC-030: status; DEC-030: source

title: Design from scan to export
statement: The technician can import a scan, apply clinic-defined corrections, review, approve and export a positive-mould STL without using another program after Artec Studio.
acceptance_criteria: In VER-10, each participating technician completes UC-02..UC-10 on an anonymised scan with no other 3D software opened

title: Know how each value was computed
statement: The technician can see, next to every cranial index value, the definition (formula, denominator, angle, plane) that produced it.
acceptance_criteria: See FR-044

title: Reproduce any past design
statement: The technician can open any saved design version and see its full ordered parameter list and regenerate identical geometry.
rationale: Recorded, revisable modification stacks are a market pattern; traceability scope.
acceptance_criteria: See FR-052, FR-053

title: Approve a specific version
statement: The technician can approve one specific design version through an explicit action separate from saving.
rationale: Approval record found in no product; required by DEC-016 and cleared-device practice (orthotist-approved case plan).
acceptance_criteria: See FR-090..FR-093

title: Find everything for a case
statement: The clinic admin can list all objects linked to a case with creator and time.
acceptance_criteria: See FR-004

title: See what the design changed
statement: The technician can see where and by how much the positive differs from the scan, in millimetres.
rationale: Deviation maps documented by Artec, Canfit, Mimics.
acceptance_criteria: See FR-070, FR-071

title: Reuse clinic correction settings
statement: The technician can save and reapply the clinic's design parameter set as a named template.
rationale: Clinic does not disclose parameters; technician enters them (OQ-017). Protocols/macros are a market pattern (TPL 8 V).
priority_rationale: Saves re-entry; flow works without it
acceptance_criteria: See FR-060..FR-062

title: Know scan problems before measuring
statement: The technician is shown scan integrity problems before landmarks or measurements are possible.
rationale: Poor scans silently accepted is a high-likelihood risk (R-04).
acceptance_criteria: See FR-013, FR-014

title: Work in Russian
statement: All users work in a Russian-language interface and receive Russian-language reports.
acceptance_criteria: See NFR-05

title: Produce a case report
statement: The clinic admin can produce a report of a case's measurements, design parameters, review results and approval.
rationale: Reports documented by Neo, Invent, Orthomerica.
priority_rationale: Records; data also viewable on screen
acceptance_criteria: See FR-110, FR-111

title: Compare visits
statement: The technician can compare a follow-up scan with an earlier one in the same frame.
rationale: Longitudinal comparison is documented by Canfit, Kinoo, Tracer; follow-up encounters are core to CRO care.
acceptance_criteria: See FR-150..FR-152

title: Create case
statement: The system shall create a case with a system-generated pseudonymous case ID and no fields for name, national ID, address or date of birth.
rationale: Brief step 1; A-10; pilot data anonymised (OQ-017).
main_behavior: Generate unique case ID; store creator and UTC time; log event
acceptance_criteria: Case created with unique ID; data model inspection shows no direct-identifier fields; event in audit log

title: Single-case ownership
statement: Every scan, measurement set, design version, export and report shall belong to exactly one case.
acceptance_criteria: DB constraint rejects objects with zero or two case links; API test confirms

title: Archive instead of delete
statement: The system shall replace deletion of cases and linked objects with archiving; archived objects are read-only and remain retrievable by the clinic admin.
error_behavior: Archive of object in active approval -> blocked with reason
acceptance_criteria: No UI/API path removes a case object; archived object visible in archive view and not editable

title: Case contents view
statement: The system shall list all objects linked to a case with type, version, creator and UTC timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: For a seeded case with N objects, list shows exactly N rows with all four fields

title: Import mesh files
statement: The system shall import triangle meshes from binary STL, ASCII STL, OBJ (geometry only) and PLY (binary and ASCII).
rationale: Owner-confirmed formats; Artec Studio exports OBJ/STL (SRC-099).
error_behavior: Unparseable/zero-face file -> rejected with reason, no case change (FR-015)
acceptance_criteria: Reference files of each format (incl. ≥3 anonymised clinic exports) import with vertex/face counts equal to a reference parser

title: Retain original file
statement: The system shall store each imported file unmodified with its SHA-256 hash and link all derived objects to that hash.
acceptance_criteria: Downloaded original is byte-identical to upload; hash shown in case view

title: Unit confirmation
statement: The system shall require the technician to confirm the file's length unit (mm, cm, m, inch) before any landmark, measurement or design operation, and shall then display bounding-box dimensions in mm.
rationale: STL carries no unit; unit errors are a listed hazard (R-03).
main_behavior: Show proposed unit and bbox; require confirm
acceptance_criteria: With unit unconfirmed, landmark/measure/design controls are disabled (UI + API); confirmation logged with user/time

title: Integrity report
statement: On import the system shall report: triangle count, vertex count, boundary loops (count and longest perimeter in mm), non-manifold edges, degenerate faces (area < ε_area mm², ε_area a kernel constant set by the VER-01 numerical analysis and printed in the report), connected components, and bounding box.
acceptance_criteria: On VER-08 defect meshes, each seeded defect is reported with correct count

title: Quality gate
statement: The system shall evaluate each integrity metric against a clinic-configured threshold with action 'block' or 'warn'; a 'warn' result can be overridden only with a typed reason.
rationale: R-04 control; thresholds cannot come from literature (G-02).
main_behavior: Compare to thresholds; show pass/warn/block per metric
error_behavior: Block -> no downstream steps; warn -> override with reason (SAF-05)
acceptance_criteria: Gate logic with test-only thresholds: metric at T passes, at T+1 unit triggers the configured action; production thresholds are entered by the clinic technician in configuration (values confidential, not recorded in project documents); pilot start requires no NOT_SET gate value

title: Reject unreadable files
statement: The system shall reject a file that cannot be parsed, has zero faces, or exceeds the size limit in NFR-03, state the reason, and leave the case unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Corrupt, empty and oversize test files each give a distinct reason; case object count unchanged

title: Remove regions
statement: The technician shall be able to select and remove mesh regions (e.g., non-head data) as a recorded operation.
rationale: Cleanup is common (CLN 8 V); kept minimal, heavy cleanup stays in Artec Studio.
acceptance_criteria: Removed face set recorded; re-application on original yields identical mesh hash

title: Fill holes
statement: The technician shall be able to fill boundary loops up to a technician-set maximum perimeter (mm), as a recorded operation.
priority_rationale: Can be done in Artec Studio
acceptance_criteria: On VER-08 holed meshes, all loops ≤ set perimeter are closed and none larger

title: Decimate
statement: The technician shall be able to reduce a mesh to a target triangle count as a recorded operation, reporting the maximum vertex displacement in mm, defined as the one-sided Hausdorff distance from the output vertices to the input surface (closest-point distance).
priority_rationale: Needed only if meshes exceed NFR-03
acceptance_criteria: Output triangle count within ±1% of target; displacement reported
v0.2_change: AUD-18: statement changed; AUD-10: source changed

title: Non-destructive cleanup
statement: Cleanup operations shall be stored as parameterised operations applied to the retained original; the technician can undo the last operation and disable any operation.
acceptance_criteria: Disabling all cleanup ops reproduces original mesh hash

title: Place named landmarks
statement: The technician shall place, move and delete named landmarks on the mesh, using the landmark set defined in the active frame definition.
rationale: Landmark frames are standard in research; rarely documented in products (LMK 1 V/2 P).
error_behavior: Landmark off-surface -> snapped to nearest surface point and flagged
acceptance_criteria: Each landmark of the active set can be placed; stored coordinates lie on surface (distance < 1e-6 mm)

title: Compute anatomical frame
statement: The system shall compute a right-handed anatomical frame from the placed landmarks per the active frame definition and display its axes and the mid-sagittal plane on the mesh.
acceptance_criteria: On VER-01 phantoms with known landmarks, axes match analytic frame within VER-01 tolerance

title: Frame confirmation gate
statement: The system shall block measurement and design operations until the technician confirms the displayed frame; confirmation is logged.
acceptance_criteria: Measurement/design API calls return 'frame not confirmed' before confirmation

title: Store frame provenance
statement: The system shall store landmark coordinates, frame definition ID and version, and confirming user/time with the case, and re-display them on demand.
acceptance_criteria: Reloading case re-displays identical landmarks and frame

title: Compute cranial indices
statement: The system shall compute CI, CVA, CVAI and head circumference on the confirmed frame using the active measurement definitions.
rationale: Owner: platform computes these four values.
error_behavior: Plane does not intersect mesh as a closed contour -> value not computed, reason shown
acceptance_criteria: Values on VER-01 phantoms within VER-01 tolerance for every definition variant

title: Versioned measurement definitions
statement: Each measurement definition shall be a versioned object specifying formula, denominator rule, diagonal angle, plane/level rule, landmark set and unit; editing creates a new version.
source: DEC-014; SRC-003, SRC-025, SRC-029, SRC-020; LIT-REV P-MEAS-1
acceptance_criteria: Edit of a definition yields version n+1; values computed under n still reference n

title: CVAI variants available
statement: The system shall provide CVAI/CVA definitions with (a) shorter-diagonal and (b) longer-diagonal denominator, each with a configurable diagonal angle, and shall ship two preset definitions with diagonal angles of 30° and 40° (DEC-027); the technician selects the definition for each measurement set; no definition is applied without that selection.
rationale: OQ-B2 effect; default must be sourced, not chosen silently.
source: DEC-014; DEC-027 (owner, 2026-11-12); OQ-B2; SRC-020, SRC-025, SRC-071; SRC-023 (unread)
acceptance_criteria: Presets at 30° and 40° present in both denominator variants; computed values match analytic values on the VER-01 asymmetric phantom within the VER-01 tolerance; UI and API refuse a measurement set without an explicitly selected definition
v0.3_change: DEC-027: statement; DEC-027: source; DEC-027: dependencies; DEC-027: acceptance_criteria

title: Value provenance
statement: Every stored index value shall carry definition ID+version, frame ID, landmark-set hash, source-mesh hash, software version, operator and UTC timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: Schema inspection + API test: no value record lacks any of the 7 fields

title: Show definition with value
statement: The UI shall display the definition name and version adjacent to every index value wherever the value appears.
acceptance_criteria: UI inspection: every screen showing a value also shows its definition label

title: No classification output
statement: The system shall not generate severity labels, thresholds, candidacy statements or colour-coded severity for any index.
rationale: Owner: no 'helmet needed' thresholds; thresholds are population/definition-specific and some circular.
acceptance_criteria: String and UI review finds no severity terms or threshold logic; code search finds no threshold constants for indices

title: Recompute creates new set
statement: Changing landmarks, frame or definition shall create a new measurement set; earlier sets remain stored and marked superseded.
acceptance_criteria: After landmark move, two sets exist; earlier flagged superseded

title: Show measurement plane
statement: The system shall render the measurement plane and the measured contour/diagonals on the mesh for each computed set.
acceptance_criteria: Plane and diagonals displayed for each set; geometry matches stored parameters

title: Define correction zone
statement: The technician shall define a zone by an anchored centre on the mesh (face ID + barycentric coordinates), a circular extent radius in mm or an elliptical extent (two radii in mm + orientation angle in degrees), a signed magnitude in mm (+ = outward on the positive) and a transition width in mm; displacement falls off with Euclidean distance from the centre (assumption A-15 until replaced by a clinic-approved rule).
rationale: Region-based rectification is the core of direct O&P CAD (RECT 8 V).
acceptance_criteria: On a sphere phantom, a zone of magnitude m yields max signed displacement m ±(VER tolerance) at centre and 0 outside extent+transition

title: Global adjustment
statement: The technician shall apply global dimensional adjustments stored as parameters: (a) a length change in mm along a frame axis (A-P, M-L or vertical), applied as uniform scaling along that axis about the frame origin; (b) a circumference change in mm at a chosen level, applied as uniform radial scaling about the vertical axis to vertices within the level band [level ± band_mm] with a linear taper of width transition_mm outside the band (assumption A-22 until confirmed with UD-05).
rationale: OMEGA region/measurement-driven adjustment; growth allowance values from clinic.
acceptance_criteria: On VER-01 phantom, +x mm A-P adjustment changes A-P length by x within tolerance

title: Parametric design regeneration
statement: A design shall be stored as (original mesh hash, cleanup ops, frame, ordered modification list); the positive shall be regenerated from these and, for identical inputs and software version, produce an identical geometry hash.
rationale: Core architectural choice; enables approval binding.
acceptance_criteria: 100 regenerations of 10 reference designs give 1 hash each

title: Edit modification stack
statement: The technician shall edit, disable, re-enable, reorder and delete operations in the modification list; each change regenerates the positive and is logged.
acceptance_criteria: Disable+re-enable an op returns the prior geometry hash

title: Zone categories
statement: Each zone shall carry a category from a clinic-configured list (initial list: contact, growth void, relief, build-up) and a name.
rationale: P-CAD-7: cleared devices describe contact zones and growth voids.
acceptance_criteria: Zone cannot be saved without category; category appears in manifest (FR-103)

title: No default correction
statement: A new design shall start with an empty modification list unless the technician applies a template.
rationale: P-CAD-1: no default 'correct shape'; parameters belong to the clinic.
acceptance_criteria: New design: modification list length = 0

title: Save design version
statement: Saving shall create an immutable design version with a version number, parent version, and the parameter list.
acceptance_criteria: Saved version cannot be modified via UI/API; edits create version n+1

title: Save template
statement: The technician shall save the current modification list (optionally excluding zone locations) as a named template with version number.
acceptance_criteria: Saved template lists the same operations and values as source design

title: Apply template
statement: The technician shall apply a template to a design; the design records template ID and version, and every applied operation remains individually editable.
acceptance_criteria: Design shows template ID+version; ops editable

title: Template versioning
statement: Editing a template shall create a new template version; existing designs keep the version they used.
acceptance_criteria: After template edit, older design still references old version

title: Deviation map
statement: The system shall display per-vertex signed distance (mm) between the positive and the source scan in the shared frame, with colour scale, numeric legend, and min/max/mean per zone.
source: CAP-07; SRC-099, SRC-077, SRC-089; LIT-REV P-CAD-2
acceptance_criteria: On sphere phantom with zone m, reported max equals m within VER-01 tolerance; legend values match stored data

title: Point query
statement: The technician shall query the signed distance at any picked point.
acceptance_criteria: Picked value equals computed distance for that vertex/face

title: Geometry validity checks
statement: The system shall check the generated positive for: zero boundary edges, manifold edges only, no self-intersections, one connected component, consistent outward normals.
rationale: Watertight, valid STL is a manufacturing prerequisite; R-05/R-06.
acceptance_criteria: Each VER-08 defect type is detected; valid phantoms pass

title: Validity failure blocks approval
statement: A design version failing any FR-080 check shall not be approvable; the report names the failed check and the count of affected elements.
acceptance_criteria: Approve control disabled and API returns reason for failing version

title: Geometry-only wording
statement: Validity results shall be labelled as geometric checks that do not establish clinical suitability or device safety.
acceptance_criteria: Label present on validity panel and in report

title: Approve design version
statement: The system shall provide an explicit 'approve' action, available only to the technician role, that requires completing the configured review checklist and binds the approval to five items: version ID, geometry hash, parameter-list hash, source scan hash and measurement set ID.
rationale: DEC-016; P-CAD-5; no product documents an approval record.
source: DEC-016; SRC-069; LIT-REV P-CAD-5; CAP-17; R-02, R-16
error_behavior: Checklist incomplete or validity fail -> blocked with reason
acceptance_criteria: Admin role cannot approve (API 403); approval stores all 5 bindings and a test altering any one of them makes FR-101 refuse export; incomplete checklist blocks
v0.2_change: AUD-06: statement changed; AUD-06: acceptance_criteria changed; AUD-05: dependencies changed

title: Approval does not carry over
statement: Any change to a design after approval shall create a new unapproved version.
acceptance_criteria: Edit after approval -> new version with status 'not approved'; old approval unchanged

title: Reject with reason
statement: The technician shall be able to reject a version with a typed reason; the rejection is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Rejected version shows reason, user, time

title: Self-approval disclosure
statement: When the approving user also authored any operation in the version, the approval record and report shall state 'designer and approver are the same person'.
acceptance_criteria: Self-approved test version shows statement in UI and report; independent approval does not

title: Export positive STL
statement: The system shall export the positive as binary STL in millimetres, in the documented export coordinate frame.
error_behavior: Write failure -> export record 'failed', no file released
acceptance_criteria: Exported STL bounding box (mm) equals in-app bbox within FR-102 tolerance

title: Export only approved geometry
statement: Export shall be enabled only for a version with a recorded approval whose geometry hash equals the hash of the geometry being exported.
acceptance_criteria: Export of unapproved or hash-mismatched version refused via UI and API

title: Re-import verification
statement: After writing, the system shall re-read the exported file and compare it to the in-app model (triangle count equal; max vertex deviation ≤ 1e-4 mm, DEC-025); on failure the export is marked failed and not released.
acceptance_criteria: Corrupted-write injection test marks export failed; normal exports pass with max deviation ≤ 1e-4 mm
v0.3_change: DEC-025: statement; DEC-025: acceptance_criteria; DEC-025: dependencies

title: Export manifest
statement: Each export shall include a machine-readable manifest with case ID, version, STL hash, units, frame definition, zone list (name, category, parameters), template version and approval record ID.
rationale: Plain STL cannot carry zone metadata (OQ-008); P-FAB-2.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest validates against schema; STL hash in manifest equals file hash

title: Case report
statement: The system shall generate a Russian-language PDF report with stored measurement values and definitions, design parameter summary, deviation map image, validity results and approval record, reproducing stored values exactly.
acceptance_criteria: Automated compare: every value in report equals DB value to stored precision; definition ID present per value

title: Report contains no interpretation
statement: Reports shall contain no interpretive, severity or recommendation text.
acceptance_criteria: Template review + VER-09 lint pass

title: Event log
statement: The system shall log create, modify, confirm, override, approve, reject, export, archive and settings-change events with user ID, UTC timestamp, object ID and version.
rationale: No product documents a formal audit trail (AUD 0 V).
acceptance_criteria: Scripted run of each event type yields one log entry each with all fields

title: Log immutability
statement: No user role shall be able to edit or delete log entries through UI or API.
acceptance_criteria: All mutate endpoints for log absent or return 403/405

title: View and export log
statement: The clinic admin shall view, filter by case/user/event/date, and export the log as CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Filtered export row count equals filtered view count

title: Two-role permission matrix
statement: The system shall enforce two roles: clinic admin (cases, users, reports, log view, archive) and technician (import, cleanup, landmarks, measurement, design, templates, approval, export); the admin role has no approval or export right.
acceptance_criteria: Permission test matrix: every role × action pair returns the specified allow/deny

title: Clinic configuration
statement: The technician shall set clinic configuration: measurement definitions, landmark/frame definitions, quality-gate thresholds, coverage check, zone categories, review checklist items, magnitude ranges, base convention, export frame and tolerances; each change creates a new version and an audit event; controlled sections follow FR-141.
rationale: Clinic does not disclose parameters; technician enters them (OQ-017).
priority_rationale: No clinic rules ship with product
acceptance_criteria: Each setting edit creates version n+1 and a log entry; objects record the config version used
v0.2_change: AUD-05: statement changed; AUD-05: dependencies changed; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Versioned change of controlled configuration with re-approval
statement: A change by a technician to a controlled configuration section (review checklist, quality-gate thresholds and actions, coverage check, plausible size range, magnitude ranges, positive base convention, export frame, re-import tolerance, real_patient_data_enabled) shall create a new configuration version with a stored diff and an audit event; every later approval record shall show that the controlled configuration in force was last changed by that user and when; a design version approved under an earlier version of a controlled section shall require re-approval under the current version before it can be exported. An optional second-person approval of controlled changes may be switched on in configuration.
rationale: Under FR-140 the approving technician could change the gate that controls his own approval (AUD-05; CF-02; Phase 7).
priority_rationale: Segregation of duties for safety-relevant settings
preconditions: Draft differs from current version in a controlled section
main_behavior: Store version n+1 and diff; mark approvals under n as needing re-approval for export
error_behavior: Export of a version approved under an outdated controlled configuration -> 409 REAPPROVAL_REQUIRED
acceptance_criteria: Controlled change creates version n+1 with diff hash and audit event; approval record shows last-changed-by/at of the controlled configuration; export of a version approved under version n after a controlled change returns REAPPROVAL_REQUIRED; with the optional switch on, a self-approved controlled change stays inactive

title: Follow-up encounter
statement: The technician shall add a follow-up encounter to a case with optional new scan, date, and notes.
rationale: Follow-up encounter is a core CRO entity; cadence clinic-configured.
acceptance_criteria: Encounter created and linked; listed chronologically

title: Visit overlay
statement: The system shall overlay two scans of a case in a shared frame and show their signed-distance map.
acceptance_criteria: Known-offset phantom pair shows expected offset

title: Trend table with definition warning
statement: The system shall tabulate index values per visit with dates and display a warning when consecutive values differ in definition or acquisition modality.
acceptance_criteria: Mixed-definition test data triggers warning; same-definition does not

title: Repeatability band
statement: Trend views shall show the locally measured repeatability band and shall not label a change smaller than the band as improvement or worsening.
rationale: P-MEAS-7; literature gives only ±1.2–1.5 CVAI points from landmarking (MRI surfaces).
acceptance_criteria: Band value equals VER-05 result; sub-band changes unlabelled

title: Encounter observations
statement: Encounters shall record fit-problem and skin-finding flags, free text, and wear time with its source (caregiver report / device), without interpretation.
acceptance_criteria: Fields stored; wear-time source mandatory when wear time entered

title: Multi-device episode
statement: A case shall hold several devices and adjustment events over one episode.
acceptance_criteria: Case with 2 devices × 3 adjustments stored and listed

title: Mirrored reference overlay
statement: The system shall display an optional mirror of one side across the mid-sagittal plane as a visual reference, never applied to the design automatically.
rationale: CAP-11; automated target derivation overlaps patents.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay toggles; design hash unchanged by toggling

title: Manual trim line + clearance checklist
statement: The technician shall draw a trim/extent curve on the positive and complete a checklist covering vision, hearing, breathing and neck movement clearance.
acceptance_criteria: Curve stored as parameter and exported in manifest; checklist mandatory before approval when curve exists

title: Shell generation
statement: The system shall generate a shell by offset with technician-set thickness and report minimum wall thickness and self-intersections.
acceptance_criteria: TBD when DEC-011 reopened

title: Read-only shared review
statement: The system shall share a read-only case view with an invited reviewer.
acceptance_criteria: TBD
v0.2_change: AUD-10: source changed; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Prescription reference attachment
statement: Before a design version can be approved, the technician shall attach the physician's prescription (referral) document to the case as a PDF, JPEG or PNG file; the file is stored unmodified with its SHA-256, is access-controlled per case, and every view or download is logged (SEC-15).
acceptance_criteria: Approval of a version whose case has no attached prescription returns PRESCRIPTION_MISSING; downloaded file is byte-identical to the upload; each view/download creates one read event
v0.2_change: AUD-05: dependencies changed; AUD-25: status normalised
v0.3_change: DEC-022: statement; DEC-022: priority; DEC-022: release; DEC-022: status; DEC-022: source; DEC-022: evidence_tier; DEC-022: dependencies; DEC-022: acceptance_criteria; DEC-022: verification_method; DEC-022: verified_by; DEC-022: actor; DEC-022: trigger

title: Scan-to-case confirmation
statement: On import the system shall display the case ID and clinic reference and require the technician to confirm the scan-to-case association before the scan can be used; confirmation is logged.
rationale: Anonymised infant scans are hard to tell apart; wrong-case association hazard (03b GAP-3, NCAP-02).
acceptance_criteria: Unconfirmed scan: landmark/measure/design API returns "case association not confirmed"; one log event per confirmation

title: Input self-intersection count
statement: The integrity report shall include the count of self-intersecting face pairs in the imported mesh.
rationale: Infant movement produces ghosted layers (R-04; CF-04).
acceptance_criteria: Seeded ghost-layer and self-intersecting meshes in VER-08 report count > 0; clean phantoms report 0

title: Post-frame coverage check
statement: After frame confirmation the system shall report, for each configured angular sector above the configured reference plane, whether surface data are present, and apply the configured block/warn action.
rationale: Cranial-vault coverage cannot be judged before a frame exists (CF-04, NCAP-05).
acceptance_criteria: Phantom with one sector removed is reported for that sector only; sector count and reference plane are clinic configuration values (confidential); pilot start requires them set

title: Positive closure and base
statement: The system shall generate a closed solid positive by closing the scan boundary with a base defined by configured parameters (base plane position in the anatomical frame, extension distance); the closure is a recorded operation in the modification list.
rationale: A head scan is open; FR-080 (zero boundary edges) cannot pass without closure (03b GAP-1, NCAP-01).
priority_rationale: Without it no MVP design can pass FR-080
inputs: Base plane position (mm, frame), extension distance (mm)
main_behavior: Cut at base plane, cap contour, extrude base; record op
error_behavior: Non-simple contour or validity failure -> op rejected, last valid geometry kept (SAF-09)
acceptance_criteria: Output passes FR-080; base plane at configured position within VER-01 tolerance; vertices above the base plane have zero displacement from closure

title: Protected regions
statement: The system shall apply clinic-configured protected regions in which a zone cannot be saved, or can be saved only after logged confirmation, per configuration.

acceptance_criteria: Zone overlapping a protected region triggers configured action

title: Latest-scan check at approval and export

acceptance_criteria: Two-scan case: approving a design on the older scan shows warning and logs confirmation; single-scan case shows none

title: Follow-up scan vs approved positive map

acceptance_criteria: Known-offset phantom pair shows expected offset

title: Uniform normal offset

rationale: Cap/stocking and liner allowance (NCAP-04; UD-15, UD-21).
acceptance_criteria: Sphere radius r offset by +d gives radius r+d within VER-01 tolerance; new design has no offset op

title: Show repeatability band or not-established text

title: Optional positive smoothing

title: Failed regeneration keeps last valid state
statement: If regeneration fails, the last valid geometry shall be retained, the failed operation shown as failed, and no version saved from the failed state.
acceptance_criteria: Injected failure leaves geometry hash unchanged

title: Positive/device sign convention
statement: Every zone, offset and adjustment control, the deviation-map legend and the manifest shall state direction as the effect on the positive surface (outward/inward, mm) and on the device inner surface (more/less space), using one convention throughout.
rationale: On a positive, outward = more space in device; inversion hazard (03b GAP-2).
acceptance_criteria: UI/manifest inspection shows both statements; VER-14 passes

title: Approval scope statement
statement: The approval action and approval record shall display a statement that approval attests the technician's review in Jude and does not establish fit, safety or clinical suitability.
rationale: Approval must not be read as clinical validation (R-02; A-06; 03b §10).
acceptance_criteria: Statement present at approval and in report; text matches approved version
status_note: Text approved by product owner 2026-11-12 (APPROVAL_GOVERNANCE v0.2 §5)

title: Visit comparisons are geometric only
statement: Comparisons between visits shall be labelled as geometric differences with no attributed cause, and shall not use improvement/worsening wording.
acceptance_criteria: Lint finds no improvement/worsening terms in comparison views; label present

title: Synthetic phantom suite
statement: Index computation, frame construction, zone displacement and deviation maps shall be verified on synthetic meshes with analytically known values for every definition variant.
acceptance_criteria: DEC-025 option A on icosphere phantoms R = 75 mm, subdivision 6: point and displacement tolerance e = 0.011 mm, section perimeter 0.032 mm, frame axis atan(2e/b), index tolerance propagated (e.g. |δCI| ≤ 100·(e/L + W·e/L²)); all phantom cases within these limits; suite automated in CI

title: Physical phantom check
statement: Before pilot use, a known-geometry physical object scanned with the clinic's Artec Eva shall be measured in Jude and compared with calliper/CAD reference values.
rationale: Cleared CRO measurement components were verified this way.
acceptance_criteria: Procedure of VERIFICATION_CRITERIA_PROPOSALS §6 executed; differences compared with limits set by the clinic (confidential); clinic records pass/fail and signs the record

title: Laterality test object
statement: An object with a known one-sided feature shall pass through import → export and keep its side.
acceptance_criteria: Test object with a one-sided feature on the patient-left side: feature shown on the side labelled L in the viewer, side-specific values computed on that side, and in the exported STL the feature centroid lies on the same side of the mid-sagittal plane; 0 mismatches across STL/OBJ/PLY inputs

title: Jude vs Rodin4D comparison
statement: On ≥10 anonymised clinic scans, Jude and Rodin4D values shall be compared with each tool's definition recorded; differences are reported, not pass/fail, until UD-01 is resolved.
acceptance_criteria: Report with per-scan differences and definitions

title: Local repeatability study
statement: ≥2 technicians shall landmark the same anonymised scans repeatedly; inter/intra-observer variability of each index shall be computed to set the repeatability band.
acceptance_criteria: Band per index with method and n recorded

title: Export round-trip
statement: Exported STL + manifest shall be verified by Jude re-import and by import into the clinic's Rodin4D Neo.
acceptance_criteria: Jude re-import: triangle count equal and max vertex deviation ≤ FR-102 tolerance for 100% of suite exports; Rodin4D Neo: file opens without repair prompt and bounding box differs ≤ FR-102 tolerance; Neo version recorded

title: Determinism test
statement: Regenerating stored designs shall reproduce stored geometry hashes.
acceptance_criteria: 100 regenerations of each of 10 reference designs give exactly 1 distinct geometry_sha per design on the CI host; second-host result recorded (ADR-010 fallback if different)
v0.2_change: AUD-16: acceptance_criteria changed; AUD-10: source changed

title: Defect mesh catalogue
statement: A catalogue of meshes with seeded defects (holes, non-manifold, self-intersection, fragments, flipped normals, corrupt/oversize files) shall be run against import and validity checks.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of seeded defects detected; 0 false failures on clean phantoms

title: Wording and localisation lint
statement: CI shall check UI strings, report templates and docs for DEC-012 words, severity terms and untranslated strings.
acceptance_criteria: 0 hits blocks merge otherwise

title: Technician usability test
statement: Clinic technicians shall perform UC-02..UC-10 on anonymised scans; completion, errors and time are recorded against the OQ-B5 success criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Completion, critical errors (wrong side/case/unit = 0) and median end-to-end design time recorded for UC-02…UC-10; time compared with the clinic's current process on comparable cases against the clinic's threshold (DEC-030)

title: Browser/hardware E2E suite
statement: Automated end-to-end run of UC-02..UC-10 on each supported browser at minimum hardware with the N-triangle reference mesh.
acceptance_criteria: Each UC-02…UC-10 E2E scenario completes with 0 failed steps on every browser in the NFR-01 list on a machine at NFR-02 minimum spec with the N-triangle reference mesh; p95 timings recorded against NFR-04 budgets

title: Permission and gate tests
statement: API-level tests for every role × action pair and for approval/export gates.
acceptance_criteria: Every role × endpoint cell of the permission-matrix YAML returns the specified status (100% of cells executed); each approval/export gate error code of 07 §8.2 and FR-141/FR-182 is triggered by ≥1 test; the 5 approval bindings of FR-090 are each tamper-tested

title: Audit completeness test
statement: Scripted session triggering every event type; log checked for completeness and hash chain.
acceptance_criteria: All event types present; chain verifies

title: Sign-convention test object
statement: A sign-convention test object shall verify that an "outward" zone of +m mm raises the positive surface by m mm and shows a positive value in the deviation map and manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Pass/fail on sphere phantom in all three outputs (UI control label, deviation map sign, manifest effect block); 0 mismatches

title: Positive closure verification
statement: Positive closure shall be verified on open phantom surfaces with boundaries of varied shape.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of phantoms yield closed valid solids meeting FR-173 criteria

title: Physical positive vs exported STL
statement: Before pilot use, at least one positive produced from a Jude export shall be measured at defined points against the exported STL by production; result recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Record exists; production compares against its own limits (confidential) and records pass/fail

title: Functional test coverage
statement: Each MVP FR/DATA/INT/SAF requirement shall have ≥1 test case TC-<req-ID> in 09_MVP_BACKLOG_AND_TEST_PLAN, passing before pilot release.
rationale: ARTIFACT_PLAN: every FR has a VER
acceptance_criteria: TC catalogue (09_TEST_CASE_CATALOGUE_v0.2.csv) lists ≥1 TC-<ID> for 100% of MVP FR/DATA/INT/SAF/SEC requirements; all pass before pilot release

title: Security test suite
statement: An automated security suite shall verify SEC-05…SEC-09, SEC-15, SEC-16, SEC-19 and SEC-20 against the pilot deployment configuration, and a threat model for the pilot deployment shall be reviewed against the suite before pilot start.
dependencies: SEC-05, SEC-06, SEC-07, SEC-08, SEC-09, SEC-15, SEC-16, SEC-19, SEC-20
acceptance_criteria: Every listed SEC acceptance criterion executed and passed on the pilot configuration; every threat in the threat model maps to ≥1 passing test or to a recorded risk acceptance by a named approver

title: Privacy controls inspection
statement: Before the first real scan is uploaded, the privacy specialist shall inspect SEC-10…SEC-14, SEC-17 and SEC-18 against the approved privacy decisions and record the result.
dependencies: SEC-10, SEC-11, SEC-12, SEC-13, SEC-14, SEC-17, SEC-18
acceptance_criteria: Signed inspection record lists each control as pass with evidence reference; any fail keeps real_patient_data_enabled false

title: Agreement with manual measurements
statement: On pilot cases, Jude values (CI, CVA, CVAI, HC under the selected definition) shall be compared with the clinic technician's manual measurements of the same infant, recording the manual method; bias and 95% limits of agreement are reported per index.
rationale: Pilot success criterion part 2 (DEC-030); differences may be definitional (R-17).
acceptance_criteria: Report per index: n, bias, 95% limits of agreement, manual method and Jude definition; compared with the clinic's threshold

title: Automatic landmark proposal
statement: Any future automatic landmark proposal shall require technician confirmation of each landmark and be validated on Jude's own optical infant scans against VER-05 observer variability before release.
rationale: Kept out of MVP (DEC-003); full readiness documentation belongs in 10_AI_ML_READINESS_ROADMAP.
acceptance_criteria: Defined in roadmap
v0.2_change: AUD-25: release normalised; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Automatic cleanup segmentation
statement: Any future automatic head/non-head segmentation shall present its result as an editable recorded operation and be evaluated against technician cleanup on the local dataset.
rationale: Kept out of MVP (DEC-003); full readiness documentation belongs in 10_AI_ML_READINESS_ROADMAP.
acceptance_criteria: Defined in roadmap
v0.2_change: AUD-25: release normalised; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Suggested zones / target shape
statement: Suggested correction zones or target shapes are research-only pending FTO review and clinic-owned rules; no output may be applied without technician action.
rationale: Kept out of MVP (DEC-003); full readiness documentation belongs in 10_AI_ML_READINESS_ROADMAP.
source: SRC-057, SRC-058, SRC-059; LIT-REV P-CAD-4; G-01
acceptance_criteria: Defined in roadmap
v0.2_change: AUD-25: release normalised; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Dataset provenance register
statement: Before any model work, each training/evaluation scan shall be recorded with consent basis, anonymisation status, device and protocol, and labeller.
rationale: Kept out of MVP (DEC-003); full readiness documentation belongs in 10_AI_ML_READINESS_ROADMAP.
acceptance_criteria: Defined in roadmap
v0.2_change: AUD-25: release normalised; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Suggestion interface
statement: Model outputs shall be stored as suggestion records and shall reach anatomy or design data only through a technician action that records model-proposed-* provenance and the suggestion ID; no kernel op takes a suggestion as input; suggestions cannot reference saved or approved versions.
rationale: ADR-015; keeps determinism and approval binding intact.
acceptance_criteria: INV-13/14 tests pass; approved version unaffected by any suggestion action
v0.2_change: AUD-01: merged from 10a CSV; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Shadow mode
statement: A model shall be able to run on new cases with outputs logged and never returned by any UI endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: INV-16: no UI endpoint returns shadow suggestions
v0.2_change: AUD-01: merged from 10a CSV; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Model registry
statement: Each model version shall be registered with artifact SHA, training snapshot SHA, evaluation report SHA, licence and status; only status 'prototype' may produce visible suggestions.
rationale: Traceability of model changes (cf. AI-SRC-04 change-control concepts).
acceptance_criteria: Registry schema review; suggestion from non-prototype model refused
v0.2_change: AUD-01: merged from 10a CSV; AUD-10: evidence_tier changed; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Per-model kill switch
statement: Each model shall be enabled per clinic configuration, default off; disabling stops new inference jobs within one poll interval and is audited.
acceptance_criteria: Disable -> no new ai.* jobs; manual path unaffected
v0.2_change: AUD-01: merged from 10a CSV; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Pre-registered evaluation
statement: Before a model moves from shadow to prototype, a pre-registered evaluation report (task metrics, baseline comparison, observer variability, calibration, subgroups) shall be approved by the clinical lead.
acceptance_criteria: Report exists with criteria dated before test-set unblinding
v0.2_change: AUD-01: merged from 10a CSV; AUD-25: release normalised; AUD-25: status normalised

title: Reserved AI audit event types
statement: Audit event types ai.dataset.exported, ai.model.registered, ai.model.enabled, ai.model.disabled and ai.suggestion.resolved shall be reserved in the MVP event catalogue.
acceptance_criteria: Event catalogue contains names; no MVP code emits them
